name: Unit GPS v1.1
summary: Receives satellite position/time and sends NMEA sentences; it does not provide Internet access.

host_bindings.notes: Unit TX (white) goes to host RX18; unit RX (yellow) goes to host TX17. This conflicts with M145 using the same PORT.C route.

For the supplied straight Grove cable, white unit TX meets host GPIO10; yellow unit RX meets GPIO9. Enable peripheral power when supplying the unit from StickS3. This occupies the same connector/pins as Grove I2C units.

support.meaning: Manufacturer documentation and source review only. No accessory driver or emulator input is implemented by this record.

first_hardware_check: Verify NMEA bytes at 115200 before diagnosing satellite reception. Older Unit GPS examples use 9600 and do not apply to v1.1.
Take the antenna to clear sky; show searching/no-fix until the parsed fix is valid and fresh. Then check coordinates and time.
troubleshooting: Indoor no-fix can be normal even when UART and power are correct.
Do not display stale coordinates as a fresh fix or use 0,0 as a missing-value substitute.
Do not automatically run example factory-reset/reconfiguration commands just to read position.

app_fixture_plan.note: Use clearly synthetic locations in app fixtures; actual location is private and should not be included in shared diagnostics.
